ferry_tip_hibpdb_title.message: Check another database for data breaches?

ferry_tip_hibpdb_text.message: KeePass doesn't check the passwords of $1 yet. New databases are never checked on their own – you can turn them on one by one in the KeePass options.

ferry_capture_page.message: Capture page for diagnostics (field structure to the diagnostic log, no contents)

ferry_edit_read_only.message: Can't be edited: the database is read-only (e.g. shared view-only).

KB_shortcut_simple_2_desc.message: Sign in to password manager / Select matched login / Show matched logins list
KB_shortcut_simple_2_desc.description: Description of keyboard shortcut setting for the primary action - exact behaviour depends on state when executed

black_list.description: List of items that cause behaviour to be disabled if they match. For example, the list of names of form fields that prevent KeePassFerry from searching for logins for the form containing that field.

conn_unknown_error.message: An unexpected error occurred when trying to connect to your password manager.
conn_unknown_error.description: Something went wrong with the plugin link but we have no idea what.

matched_logins_label.description: Header for panels/sections that contain the logins which KeePassFerry matched for this page/form

pref_DoNothing_desc.description: Label for configuring KeePassFerry to take no action. Specific context may vary but will relate to auto filling and/or submitting

pref_FillAndSubmitForm_desc.message: Fill in and submit the form

pref_FillingEntries_heading.description: Heading for section of options panel which contains settings relating to how KeePassFerry behaves when filling entries into forms

pref_FindingEntries_heading.description: Heading for section of options panel which contains settings relating to how KeePassFerry behaves when finding entries for a website

pref_SavingEntries_heading.description: Heading for section of options panel which contains settings relating to how KeePassFerry behaves when saving new entries

pref_autoFillFormsWithMultipleMatches_la.message: Also do this when several matching entries are found
pref_autoFillFormsWithMultipleMatches_la.description: In reference to the Automatic form filling option, this checkbox option allows the user to say whether they want their selected action to be taken even when there is more than one matching entry.

pref_autoFillFieldsWithExistingValue_lab.message: Automatically fill fields that already contain text
pref_autoFillFieldsWithExistingValue_lab.description: This checkbox option allows the user to say whether they want fields to be auto-filled if they already have a value. It doesn't affect manual fill requests.

pref_preferToSkipWhere_label.message: Automatically save new entries to the group you most recently saved to
pref_preferToSkipWhere_label.description: Whether KeePassFerry will save new entries to the group most recently chosen by the user without presenting them with the usual Where group chooser interface

pref_saveFavicons_label.description: Whether or not KeePassFerry will save the website's icon when a new entry is saved

pref_standard_form_choice_desc.message: When KeePassFerry chooses a matching login for a standard form, KeePassFerry should
pref_standard_form_choice_desc.description: Context/label for user when changing setting relating to auto-fill/submit behaviour. A list of potential actions will be displayed immediately after this string and the user can select their preferred behaviour from that list.

pref_when_user_chooses_desc.message: When you choose a matched login, KeePassFerry should
pref_when_user_chooses_desc.description: Context/label for user when changing setting relating to manual fill/submit behaviour. A list of potential actions will be displayed immediately after this string and the user can select their preferred behaviour from that list.

site_options_invisible_tip_desc.message: NB: The names and IDs may not be the same as visible labels on the page (they are set in the source code of the page)
site_options_invisible_tip_desc.description: Explains that the configuration settings might not be what the casual user expects

site_options_list_explain_desc.message: If a form matches against one of the include lists below KeePassFerry will always try to fill it. If a form matches one of the exclude lists below KeePassFerry will never try to fill it. If it matches both lists KeePassFerry will not try to fill it.
site_options_list_explain_desc.description: Explains how KeePassFerry chooses which forms to fill in

pref_Finding_forms_heading.description: Settings heading for how KeePassFerry finds forms it is (or isn't) interested in filling in with entries from the password manager

site_options_valid_form_intro_desc.message: KeePassFerry fills matching KeePass entries into every form that has a password field. You can adjust this behaviour below.
site_options_valid_form_intro_desc.description: Explains how KeePassFerry chooses which forms to fill in

white_list.description: List of items that cause behaviour to be enabled if they match. For example, the list of names of form fields that force KeePassFerry to search for logins for the form containing that field.

Menu_Button_open_keepass_label.description: Action button to launch, unlock and/or focus KeePass

copy.description: Prefixed before a field name and id to indicate to the user that when they click here the value for that field will be copied to the clipboard. Displayed before (left) of the field name with a space between this string and the field name.

copy_value_to_clipboard.description: Indicates to the user that when they click here the value for that field will be copied to the clipboard.

click_to_reveal_hide.description: Indicates to the user that when they click here the value of the protected field will be displayed or hidden (toggled).

no_name.description: Used in place of a field name when the specific field has no name. Will be surrounded by [ square brackets ]

generatePassword_done_2.message: Paste it into a "new password" field or wherever else you want.

loggedIn_tip.message: You are logged in to your '$1' password database
loggedIn_tip.description: Tells the user they are logged into a KeePassFerry Vault or KeePass database (and gives its name, if any)

loggedInMultiple_tip.message: You are logged in to $1 password databases. '$2' is active.
loggedInMultiple_tip.description: Tells the user they have more than one KeePass database open and tells them which one is active/selected

multiplePasswordSourcesEnabled.description: Tells the user how many password databases they have open and unlocked

matchedLogin_tip.description: Tooltip displayed over a matched login in the list of matched logins. Params: 1: entry title, 2: group name, 3: username

notifyBarLaunchKeePass_label.message: You are not logged in to your password manager.

notifyBarLoginToKeePassButton_tip.message: Unlock your KeePass database to use KeePassFerry.

close.description: Action user can click on to close/dismiss a panel or other user interface element

autoclose_countdown.description: Label for a user interface element which allows the user to disable the auto-close functionality. Also tells the user how many seconds are remaining before the auto-close functionality triggers.

autoclose_cancelled.description: Tells the user that the panel auto-close functionality has been disabled for this panel.

add.description: Action button for user to add an item to a collection. E.g. add an entry to the list of site-specific settings overrides

edit.description: Action button for user to edit an item within a collection. E.g. edit an entry within the list of site-specific settings overrides

delete.description: Action button for user to delete an item within a collection. E.g. delete an entry within the list of site-specific settings overrides

target.description: For differentiating which part of a URL will be matched - e.g domain, hostname or complete page address

method.description: For differentiating how a text string will be matched - e.g exact, prefix or regex

weight.description: A number that can be compared to others in order to decide which associated configuration takes precendence.

password.description: Amazingly, didn't have a need for this translation until v2.0 ;-)

pref_when_one_matching_network_login.message: When KeePassFerry finds only one matching network login (e.g. HTTP Auth), automatically login
pref_when_one_matching_network_login.description: When the user selects this option, they will be shown the popup dialog with all matching entries for network authentication, unless there is only one match. If not enabled, the user will always see the list of matching logins.

network_authentication.description: Heading for popup dialog displayed when HTTP Auth or a proxy requires authentication.

network_auth_proxy_description.message: A proxy requires you to authenticate with it before you can access $1
network_auth_proxy_description.description: Instructions for popup dialog displayed when a proxy requires authentication.

network_auth_http_auth_description.message: A website requires you to authenticate with it before you can access $1. The website says: $2
network_auth_http_auth_description.description: Instructions for popup dialog displayed when a site requires authentication using HTTP Auth.

network_auth_choose.message: Choose a login from the list below or close this window to manually enter the required login information.
network_auth_choose.description: Instructions for popup dialog displayed when a site or proxy requires network authentication.

welcome_to_kee.description: Header for release notes page. May have a version suffix added to it. E.g. Welcome to KeePassFerry 2.0

continue.description: Call to action to proceed with the next step in a process. E.g. asking the browser UI to prompt the user with a new question.

notification_raised_title.message: KeePassFerry has a notification to show you
notification_raised_title.description: Title of a transient native notification displayed on the user's screen to alert them to a notification in the KeePassFerry browser action popup.

notification_yellow_background.message: The KeePassFerry button has a yellow background when a new notification appears.
notification_yellow_background.description: Part of the message within a transient native notification displayed on the user's screen to alert them to a notification in the KeePassFerry browser action popup.

loading.description: Holding message to be displayed when KeePassFerry has to display something to the user to indicate that the requested information or interface element will be displayed shortly.

pref_currentSearchTermTimeout_label.description: Setting label to adjust how long the search text a user typed will remain cached, essentially persisting the popup search results for a short time.

pref_automatic.description: Group of settings that relate to the actions that KeePassFerry can take automatically when filling entries

pref_manual.description: Group of settings that relate to the actions that KeePassFerry takes when the user explicitly asks KeePassFerry to fill an entry

pref_fill_override_hint.message: You can override this behaviour for individual entries in KeePass.
pref_fill_override_hint.description: Statement to inform the user that they are able to override the associated (automatic) behaviour on a per-entry basis via KeePassFerry Vault or KeePass.

pref_fill_override_option.message: Editing the Auto-submit behaviour of an entry also overrides this behaviour
pref_fill_override_option.description: Checkbox option to allow the user to override the associated (manual) behaviour on a per-entry basis via KeePassFerry Vault or KeePass.

next.description: Action button for user to advance to the next step in a multi-step process. E.g. to confirm username and password for a new entry and load the panel that allows selection of where to save the new entry.

title.description: E.g. the title of an entry.

username.description: Use the most generic and common term available for the primary sign-in identifier for an account. In practice may be an email address, number, surname, username, etc. but in all cases this will refer to the string the user has stored in the entry's primary Username field.

enabled.description: Indicates that a boolean option such as a checkbox is in an enabled/on/true state

disabled.description: Indicates that a boolean option such as a checkbox is in an disabled/off/false state

unsaved_changes.description: Shown to user when the popup is opened and a new or existing entry is part-way through being edited from a recent popup session. Note that very recent popup sessions are automatically 'continued' without the user needing to consider this information.

continue_saving.description: Action for user to continue editing the same entry that was being edited when the popup recently closed.

discard_changes.description: Action for user to abandon the changes to the entry that were in progress when the popup recently closed.

password_profile_hint.message: Select which set of rules the new password will follow. Rules include password length and the sort of characters that may be used. Create new profiles in your password manager.
password_profile_hint.description: Explains what a password profile is and how to create new ones.

password_profile.description: Name of the profiles used by KeePass and KeePassFerry Vault to construct new random passwords.

url_mismatch_1.message: This entry is for a different site.
url_mismatch_1.description: 1st sentence of a warning message to notify the user that updating the entry will enable its use on a new website.

url_mismatch_2.message: Continuing with this update will enable you to fill these credentials into this site too.
url_mismatch_2.description: 2nd sentence of a warning message to notify the user that updating the entry will enable its use on a new website.

url_mismatch_3.message: Make sure this is not an attempt to trick you into revealing your password!
url_mismatch_3.description: 3rd sentence of a warning message to notify the user that updating the entry will enable its use on a new website.

url_mismatch_confirm.message: I understand the risk; Share these credentials with $1.
url_mismatch_confirm.description: Label for a confirmation checkbox for the user to affirm that they want to enable the use of an entry on a new website.

open_full_editor.description: Button action to open the full entry editor in KeePass or KeePassFerry Vault. Be sure to imply that the need to click the button is 'unusual', as I have done with the word 'advanced'

where.description: Brief question to the user to introduce the section in the popup where they can select where their entry will be saved (which database, group, etc.)

password_will_be_set_on_field.message: Your password field will be set to this password

also_copy_to_clipboard.description: Explains that enabling this option will copy the value to the clipboard in addition to the default behaviour

generator_action_copy.description: Action button to copy to the clipboard a value such as a newly generated password

generator_action_insert.description: Action button to insert a newly generated password into the field that was right-clicked

generator_action_apply.description: Action button to apply a change such as a newly generated password. Resulting alterations are not persisted immediately.

generator_action_apply_and_copy.description: Action button to both copy and apply a change such as a newly generated password. Resulting alterations are not persisted immediately.

skip_where_reason_domain_entry_exists.message: You're seeing this question because an entry for this domain already exists
skip_where_reason_domain_entry_exists.description: Explains why user is being asked where to save a new entry despite having previously requested to not be asked.

skip_where_reason_group_not_found.message: You're seeing this question because the group you most recently saved to can not be found. This may be because it has been deleted or hidden from KeePassFerry. Or it could simply be that the required password source is not unlocked.
skip_where_reason_group_not_found.description: Explains why user is being asked where to save a new entry despite having previously requested to not be asked.

skip_where_enable_context.description: Description of checkbox that when enabled will change a setting such that the user is not prompted where to save future entries they create.

theme.description: The visual theme applied to the extension's user interface. As per convention, the values refer to the predominant shade - i.e. the background colour

dark.description: Black colour or similar; Darkened visual appearance

light.description: White colour or similar; Bright visual appearance

system_preference.description: The user's configured preference/setting in their system. System is vague because different browsers will implement it in different ways so it could relate to either the user's operating system, their web browser or both.

theme_system_preference_explanation.message: Not every system applies the appearance automatically. If needed, choose it here.
theme_system_preference_explanation.description: Explains what the Theme preference does and why

pref_Appearance_heading.description: Heading for settings/options that relate to the visual appearance of the extension

preferred_matching_entry.description: Label for toggle between preferred status for the specific matched entry the toggle is displayed upon.

show_confirmation_after_save.message: Show confirmation after entry is saved
show_confirmation_after_save.description: Label for option to display a confirmation message in the main popup after user has created or updated an entry.

saveNotice_text.message: The login details you just entered are not saved in KeePass yet.

updateNotice_title.description: KeePassFerry save notice (password of an existing entry changed)

updateNotice_text.message: Save the new password for $1 in KeePass. The old one stays in the entry history.
updateNotice_text.description: KeePassFerry save notice (password of an existing entry changed); $1 is the username or entry title

updateNotice_save.description: KeePassFerry save notice (password of an existing entry changed)

otp_code_tip.message: One-time code, valid for $1 more seconds

otpNotice_text.message: Save the key for $1 in KeePass. KeePassFerry will then fill in the one-time codes for you.

otpSetup_choose.message: Which entry does this key belong to?

otpSetup_replaceWarning.message: This entry already contains a two-factor key. The previous key is kept in the entry history.

otpSetup_done.message: The first code has been entered on the page.

otpSetup_none.message: No matching entry found. Search for the entry above.

otpSetup_error.message: Saving failed. Please check that KeePass is unlocked.

otpSetup_nothing.message: No two-factor key was found on this page.

action_keepass_not_running.message: KeePassFerry – not connected to KeePass. Please start KeePass.

action_unlock_keepass.message: KeePass is locked – click to unlock

attachment_paste_hint.message: Add a screenshot, QR code or two-factor key – or drop an image here

attachment_failed.message: The image could not be saved (images up to 20 MB only, KeePass must be unlocked).

pairing_message.message: KeePass now shows a verification code. If it matches $1, click "Connect" in KeePass.

pairing_denied.message: The pairing was declined in KeePass. KeePassFerry will ask again in one minute.

pairing_needs_plugin_update.message: To pair, KeePassFerry needs a newer version of the KeePass plugin. Please update the plugin (KeePass → KeePassFerry → Check for updates) and restart KeePass.

security_server_key_changed.message: The KeePass side is not the one KeePassFerry is paired with (different key or a different KeePass installation), so KeePassFerry will not connect. If you have set up KeePass or the plugin again, or want to use another KeePass, reset the pairing in the settings.

passkey_create_question.message: Which entry should the passkey be saved in?

passkey_replace_warning.message: This entry already has a passkey. It will be replaced; the previous one is kept in the entry history.

passkey_get_question_one.message: Sign in with this passkey from KeePass:

passkey_get_question_many.message: Which passkey from KeePass do you want to use?

passkey_signal_question_one.message: The website reports that this passkey no longer exists there. Do you want to remove it from KeePass?

passkey_signal_question_many.message: The website reports that these passkeys no longer exist there. Choose the passkey you want to remove from KeePass.

passkey_signal_recycle.message: The entry only contains this passkey and will be moved to the recycle bin.

passkey_signal_fields.message: Only the passkey will be removed. Username, password and all other data are kept; the previous state remains in the entry history.

ferry_status_locked_hint.message: As soon as a page needs credentials, KeePass asks for Windows Hello or your master password.

ferry_status_blocked_hint.message: The pairing was declined or KeePass presented a different key than before. If you caused this (e.g. by setting up KeePass again), reset the pairing.

ferry_status_no_host_hint.message: Install the KeePassFerry plugin in KeePass and start KeePass once so the connection can be set up.

ferry_status_not_running_hint.message: Start KeePass. The connection is then established automatically.

ferry_reset_pairing_hint.message: Creates a new key for this browser. KeePass then asks again with a verification code.

ferry_reset_pairing_confirm.message: Do you really want to reset the pairing with KeePass? You will then confirm a new verification code in KeePass.

ferry_status_pairing_hint.message: KeePass shows a verification code. Only click “Connect” there if it reads $1.

ferry_popup_locked_hint.message: Unlock your database so KeePassFerry can suggest logins.

ferry_welcome_intro.message: KeePassFerry connects your browser directly to KeePass: logins, one-time codes and passkeys come securely from your database, without open network ports.

ferry_welcome_permission_text.message: To detect and fill login forms, the extension needs access to the websites you visit. Your data never leaves your computer.

ferry_welcome_step1_title.message: Install the KeePassFerry plugin in KeePass

ferry_welcome_step1_text.message: Download and run the setup. It finds KeePass, closes it briefly and installs the plugin. For the portable KeePass version, select the KeePass folder.

ferry_welcome_step2_text.message: The connection is established automatically. If the database is locked, unlock it by clicking the lock icon, e.g. with Windows Hello.

ferry_welcome_step3_text.message: The first time, the browser and KeePass show the same 6-digit code. If it matches, click “Connect” in KeePass.

ferry_welcome_ready_hint.message: KeePassFerry is connected to KeePass. You can close this page.

ferry_welcome_pin.message: Tip: Pin KeePassFerry to the toolbar. Click the puzzle icon (Extensions) and then the pin icon next to KeePassFerry.

ferry_otp_icon_label.message: KeePassFerry: fill in the current one-time code

ferry_diag_hint.message: For troubleshooting: KeePassFerry logs its steps (detected fields, decisions) to Documents\KeePassFerry\diagnose.log. Passwords, codes and field contents are never logged.

ferry_otp_icon_remaining.message: Code valid for $1 more seconds – click to fill in a new code

ferry_otp_icon_locked.message: KeePass is locked – click to unlock and fill in the current code

ferry_field_icon_locked.message: KeePass is locked – click to unlock

ferry_add_failed.message: Could not save. Please check that KeePass is unlocked.

ferry_add_maybe_totp.message: This looks like a two-factor key.

ferry_add_saved_directly.message: Changes are applied when you click “Save”.

ferry_add_totp_no_qr.message: The image contains no valid two-factor QR code.

ferry_add_totp_paste_hint.message: Paste a link, a key or a screenshot of the QR code

ferry_add_totp_invalid.message: Not a valid two-factor key (otpauth link or Base32 key).

ferry_add_totp_replaces.message: Replaces the existing key (the previous one stays in the history)

ferry_entry_delete_question.message: Move “$1” to the KeePass recycle bin?

ferry_entry_delete_hint.message: You can restore it from the recycle bin in KeePass.

ferry_entry_delete_disabled.message: The recycle bin is turned off in this database. Please delete the entry directly in KeePass.

ferry_entry_delete_in_bin.message: The entry is already in the recycle bin. You can delete it permanently in KeePass.

ferry_entry_delete_failed.message: The entry could not be deleted. Is KeePass unlocked?

extDescription.message: Fill logins, one-time codes and passkeys from your own KeePass database on Windows – no cloud, no open ports.

ferry_setting_autoFillOtp_hint.message: Off: the code field only shows the icon; clicking it fills the code.

ferry_password_leaked.description: KeePassFerry: result of the KeePass plugin HIBP Offline Check

ferry_password_leaked_count.message: Password found $1 times in data breaches

ferry_password_leaked_hint.message: According to "Have I Been Pwned". Change it on the website.

ferry_open_website.message: Open website in a new tab

ferry_generator_site_profile.description: KeePassFerry: generator profile from the website's password rules

ferry_generator_site_rules_hint.message: Rules of the website, otherwise it rejects the password.

ferry_news_1_0_14_1_text.message: In the edit window, "Delete entry" moves the entry to the KeePass recycle bin, never permanently.

ferry_news_1_0_14_2_text.message: Registering a passkey on GitHub and similar sites works again.

ferry_news_1_0_14_3_text.message: Stricter pairing with KeePass, no automatic filling on unencrypted pages, verified updates.

ferry_news_1_0_13_1_title.message: Add selected text to an entry

ferry_news_1_0_13_1_text.message: Right-click selected text, e.g. recovery codes, to save it in the matching entry.

ferry_news_1_0_13_2_text.message: After a password change, KeePassFerry offers to update the existing entry.

ferry_news_1_0_13_3_text.message: If a site's key is already stored, KeePassFerry does not ask again.

ferry_tips_none.message: All set. There are no tips right now.

ferry_tips_not_connected.message: Tips appear once KeePass is running and the database is unlocked.

ferry_news_1_0_15_1_text.message: If you like, KeePass checks your passwords at "Have I Been Pwned" in the background. New findings appear as a card in the popup, and affected entries offer a direct way to change the password.

ferry_news_1_0_15_4_text.message: Entries with an expiry date remind you to change the password before and after it, or are hidden once expired. When saving, you can pick a new expiry period right away.

ferry_news_1_0_15_5_text.message: Every generated password is also stored in KeePass, group "Generated passwords", with website and time. You can turn this off under "Saving entries".

ferry_news_1_0_15_2_title.message: Generator knows the rules of many websites

ferry_news_1_0_15_2_text.message: Generated passwords match the website's requirements, e.g. length and allowed special characters.

ferry_news_1_0_15_3_title.message: Change a password in one click

ferry_news_1_0_15_3_text.message: On many websites the key button at an entry opens the page for changing the password directly.

ferry_tip_pin_text.message: The icon is hidden in the extensions menu. Click the puzzle piece at the top right, then the pin next to KeePassFerry, to keep it visible.

ferry_tip_shortcut_text.message: Press $SHORTCUT$ to fill the website's username and password into the login form without opening the popup.

ferry_tip_shortcutset_text.message: Set a keyboard shortcut to fill in logins without opening the popup.

ferry_tip_passkey_text.message: If a website offers passkeys, set one up: KeePassFerry stores it in KeePass, and you then sign in without a password.

ferry_tip_diag_text.message: It is only meant for troubleshooting. Turn it off when you no longer need it.

ferry_tip_hibp_text.message: KeePass checks your passwords at "Have I Been Pwned". Only 5 characters of a checksum are sent, never the password.

ferry_tip_winhello_text.message: Fingerprint, face or PIN instead of the master password, with the KeePass plugin KeePassWinHello.

ferry_tip_otp_text.message: When you set up two-factor sign-in, KeePassFerry recognises the QR code and saves it in the entry. After that it fills in the codes itself.

ferry_tip_browsersaving_title.message: Turn off the browser's password saving

ferry_tip_browsersaving_text.message: The browser still offers to save passwords itself. KeePassFerry takes care of that, so there are no duplicate prompts.

ferry_expiry_hint.message: Change it on the website, then save the entry.

ferry_setting_networkAuth_hint.message: Offers matching entries for the browser's own sign-in dialogs (e.g. router, NAS, proxy). Off by default because such dialogs can also be triggered by embedded third-party content.

ferry_setting_detectOtpSetup_hint.message: Offers to save a QR code or otpauth link from the page in the matching entry.

ferry_setting_passkeys_hint.message: Off: passkey requests from websites go to Edge or Windows.

ferry_setting_fieldIcons_hint.message: Off: choose entries only via the KeePassFerry toolbar icon.

ferry_setting_browserSaving_hint.message: Avoids duplicate save prompts from Edge and KeePassFerry.

ferry_plugin_update_message.message: The KeePassFerry plugin in KeePass is older than this extension. “Update now” downloads and installs the setup; KeePass closes briefly and restarts.

ferry_extras_unsupported.message: Fields and attachments require a newer KeePassFerry version in KeePass.

ferry_plugin_update_none.message: No newer version for KeePass has been released yet. The installed plugin is up to date.

ferry_plugin_update_unsafe.message: The update was not installed because the release files are not correctly signed. Please do not download the setup for now and report the problem on GitHub.

ferry_clipboard_empty.message: The clipboard contains nothing to paste.

ferry_clipboard_no_image.message: The clipboard contains no image and no two-factor key.

ferry_clipboard_denied.message: Please allow pasting from the clipboard in the settings. Until then, Ctrl+V works.

ferry_setting_clipboardRead_hint.message: Enables the “Paste from clipboard” button when editing an entry. KeePassFerry only reads the clipboard when you click it. Ctrl+V works without this permission as well.

ferry_extras_load_failed.message: Could not load. Please check that KeePass is unlocked and the plugin is up to date.

ferry_extras_notes_cleared.message: Applying an empty text removes the notes.

ferry_netauth_question_one.message: Sign in with this entry from KeePass:

ferry_netauth_question_many.message: Which entry from KeePass do you want to sign in with?

ferry_netauth_question_new.message: KeePass has no entry for this yet. Enter your sign-in details:

ferry_netauth_proxy.message: The proxy $1 requires you to sign in

ferry_menu_add_field.message: Add this field to the entry …

selSave_field_noTarget.message: This field can't be added. Please right-click directly into a single-line input field that you can edit.

selSave_field_noIdentifier.message: The page gives this field no identifier ("id" or "name"), so KeePassFerry can't find it again later. You can save the value as a custom field and fill it in from the list at the field (⋯).

selSave_field_masked.message: The page only shows asterisks or dots in this field. The real value is not in the field, so KeePassFerry cannot take it over. Enter it in KeePass yourself.

selSave_field_otp.message: This is a field for one-time codes. KeePassFerry fills in the code itself once the entry has a two-factor key.

selSave_nothing.message: The selection is no longer available. Please select the text again and choose "Add to entry" in the context menu.

selSave_error.message: Could not save. Please check that KeePass is unlocked and the plugin is up to date.

ferry_leaks_intro.message: These passwords appear in known data breaches. Change them on the website and enter the new password in the entry.

ferry_news_1_0_28_1_title.message: Sign-in windows of routers and NAS

ferry_news_1_0_28_1_text.message: KeePassFerry now unlocks the database for them, asks for username and password on new devices and offers to save them. Turn it on in the settings under "Fill the browser's sign-in dialogs". This needs the current plugin.

ferry_news_1_0_27_1_text.message: The database settings in KeePass now explain exactly what the placeholder setting does. This needs the current plugin.

ferry_news_1_0_26_1_text.message: Entry icons now come from KeePass in full size and are shown at 16 px, as in KeePass. This also needs the current plugin.

ferry_news_1_0_25_1_title.message: Added fields now live in KeePass

ferry_news_1_0_25_1_text.message: Fields from "Add this field to the entry" are stored under Advanced → String fields. Password fields are protected, and everything stays usable without KeePassFerry.

ferry_news_1_0_25_2_text.message: A click expands a search result instead of changing the page. Open the website with "Website" in the expanded entry or with Ctrl+click in a new tab.

ferry_news_1_0_24_1_title.message: Name your pairings, dialogs scale correctly

ferry_news_1_0_24_1_text.message: You can give each pairing its own name and change it in the KeePassFerry options. The plugin windows now follow the Windows display scaling.

ferry_news_1_0_24_2_text.message: Databases with the check turned off no longer appear in the list. Entries without a website, such as an AutoOpen entry, no longer show a path or a "Change password" button.

ferry_news_1_0_22_1_title.message: Add exactly the fields you need

ferry_news_1_0_22_1_text.message: Saving now only stores the username and password. If a field such as a PIN is missing, right-click it → KeePassFerry → "Add this field to the entry". It is then filled in every time.

ferry_news_1_0_22_2_title.message: Two-factor notice only for a real key

ferry_news_1_0_22_2_text.message: The notice now only appears for a QR code or otpauth link with a valid key. Under Add → Two-factor key you can also paste a screenshot of the QR code.

ferry_news_1_0_22_3_title.message: Set the URL match accuracy in one place

ferry_news_1_0_22_3_text.message: The setting is now under Tools → KeePassFerry → Options and applies to all databases on this PC. Existing values are taken over once.

ferry_news_1_0_21_1_title.message: Your own fields straight into the field

ferry_news_1_0_21_1_text.message: The ⋯ button of the list at a field now also lists the fields you created in KeePass yourself (Advanced → String fields, e.g. PIN or customer number). A click fills them in, ⧉ copies them.

ferry_news_1_0_21_2_text.message: At the bottom of the ⋯ button, "Open in KeePass" opens the entry in KeePass' edit window – where you maintain it anyway.

ferry_news_1_0_20_1_title.message: Single values straight into the field

ferry_news_1_0_20_1_text.message: In the list at a field, each entry now has a ⋯ button. It fills the username, password, one-time code or another field of the entry into exactly the field the list belongs to – handy when a site builds a field differently than usual. The small ⧉ next to it copies.

ferry_news_1_0_20_2_text.message: If the one-time code field is built as a password field (e.g. "totp"), it now gets the code instead of the password, and you are no longer offered to replace your password with the code. False "Two-factor key found" notices on ordinary pages are rarer.

ferry_news_1_0_20_3_text.message: Another open database is no longer checked on its own. A tip takes you to the KeePass options, where you turn it on one by one. This needs plugin 1.0.20.

ferry_news_1_0_19_1_text.message: On logins in two steps (e.g. Google), KeePassFerry remembers the username from the first step. If there is no entry for it yet, nothing is filled in, and after signing in you are offered to save the new account – even with the same password as another account.

ferry_news_1_0_19_2_text.message: The bottom of the popup shows which databases are open; a click shows which one is active and which can only be read. With several databases, each entry shows which one it is in.

ferry_news_1_0_19_3_text.message: A read-only database is no longer offered for saving, its entries can't be edited (the pen tells you why), and the breach check skips it. This needs plugin 1.0.19.

ferry_news_1_0_18_1_title.message: Copy the one-time code from the list at the field

ferry_news_1_0_18_1_text.message: For entries with a one-time code, the clock button in the list at the login field copies the current code. It is fetched from KeePass only when you click.

ferry_news_1_0_18_2_title.message: The list closes when you click next to it

ferry_news_1_0_18_2_text.message: A click on the page next to the "Matching logins" list closes it. You no longer need the ×.

ferry_news_1_0_18_3_text.message: On pages with an eye in the password field (e.g. Microsoft), the KeePassFerry icon no longer jumps back and forth, and the list lines up with the field.

ferry_news_1_0_17_1_text.message: You now set the breach check, expired entries and the advance warning in KeePass (Tools → KeePassFerry options). They apply to all connected browsers; "Set in KeePass" in the extension's settings takes you straight there.

ferry_news_1_0_17_2_text.message: Generated passwords no longer create a backup entry in KeePass. You can delete existing backups in the group "Generated passwords" if you don't need them.

ferry_news_1_0_17_3_title.message: Edit an entry from the list at the field

ferry_news_1_0_17_3_text.message: The pencil in the list at the login field opens the entry directly in the edit window.

ferry_news_1_0_16_1_title.message: Plugin update right from the popup

ferry_news_1_0_16_1_text.message: If the KeePassFerry plugin in KeePass is older than the extension, the popup shows a notice. "Update now" installs the new plugin; the notice then disappears by itself.

ferry_news_1_0_16_2_text.message: Logins are also offered on related sites of a provider, now for about 200 more providers (from Apple's open list), e.g. all country sites of Mercado Libre or Eventbrite.

ferry_setting_in_keepass_hint.message: Set in KeePass and applies to all browsers (KeePassFerry options in KeePass).

ferry_open_keepass_options_unavailable.message: KeePass with the KeePassFerry plugin 1.0.17 or later must be running and the database unlocked.
